program:
given parcels: List of Any length 1..100.
for parcel in parcels do
  assert parcel.length > 0 and parcel.width > 0 and parcel.height > 0.
  assert parcel.actual > 0 and parcel.divisor > 0 and parcel.increment > 0.
  assert parcel.rate >= 0 and parcel.limit >= 0 and parcel.fee >= 0.
  assert parcel.threshold >= 0 and parcel.promotion >= 0 and parcel.numerator >= 0 and parcel.denominator > 0.
  let area_value = parcel_area(parcel.length,parcel.width).
  let volume_value = parcel_volume(parcel.length,parcel.width,parcel.height).
  let dimensional_value = dimensional_weight(volume_value,parcel.divisor).
  let weight_value = billable_weight(parcel.actual,dimensional_value).
  let units_value = billing_units(weight_value,parcel.increment).
  let base_value = base_charge(units_value,parcel.rate).
  let oversized_value = is_oversized(max(parcel.length,parcel.width,parcel.height),parcel.limit).
  let extra_value = oversize_charge(oversized_value,parcel.fee).
  let subtotal_value = parcel_subtotal(base_value,extra_value).
  let discount_value = parcel_discount(subtotal_value,parcel.threshold,parcel.promotion).
  let taxable_value = taxable_charge(subtotal_value,discount_value).
  let tax_value = sales_tax(taxable_value,parcel.numerator,parcel.denominator).
  let total_value = parcel_total(taxable_value,tax_value).
  let row = {id: parcel.id, area: area_value, volume: volume_value, dimensional: dimensional_value, billable: weight_value, units: units_value, base: base_value, oversized: oversized_value, extra: extra_value, subtotal: subtotal_value, discount: discount_value, taxable: taxable_value, tax: tax_value, total: total_value}.
end.
let result = {quotes: row, count: len(row), total: sum([item.total for item in row])}.
show result as "parcel quotations".

steps.instruction: Multiply length by width to obtain rectangular base area in square centimetres; inputs are positive whole centimetres.
steps.name: parcel_area

steps.instruction: Multiply the accepted parcel_area(length,width) by height to obtain volume in cubic centimetres; inputs are positive whole centimetres.
steps.name: parcel_volume

steps.instruction: Divide volume by divisor and round upward to a whole gram, including when the division leaves a remainder; volume and divisor are positive whole numbers and divisor is cubic centimetres per gram.
steps.name: dimensional_weight

steps.instruction: Choose the greater of actual and dimensional weight, in grams; both are positive whole numbers.
steps.name: billable_weight

steps.instruction: Divide billable weight by the positive gram increment and round upward to a whole number of billing units, including a partial final unit.
steps.name: billing_units

steps.instruction: Multiply the whole number of billing units by the nonnegative price in cents per unit to obtain the base charge in cents.
steps.name: base_charge

steps.instruction: Return true only when longest, the longest edge in whole centimetres, is strictly greater than limit; equality is not oversized.
steps.name: is_oversized

steps.instruction: Return the nonnegative fee in cents if oversized is true; otherwise return zero cents.
steps.name: oversize_charge

steps.instruction: Add the accepted nonnegative base charge and oversize charge to obtain the subtotal in cents.
steps.name: parcel_subtotal

choices: if subtotal >= threshold then min(promotion,subtotal) else 0
if subtotal > threshold then min(promotion,subtotal) else 0
if subtotal >= threshold then promotion else 0
if subtotal < threshold then min(promotion,subtotal) else 0
steps.instruction: If subtotal is at least threshold, return the lesser of promotion and subtotal; otherwise return zero; all inputs are nonnegative cents, so the discount never exceeds subtotal.
steps.name: parcel_discount

steps.instruction: Subtract the accepted discount from subtotal to obtain the taxable charge in cents; inputs obey zero <= discount <= subtotal.
steps.name: taxable_charge

steps.instruction: Multiply the nonnegative taxable amount by numerator divided by the positive denominator and round upward to whole cents; numerator is nonnegative and the fraction is the tax rate.
steps.name: sales_tax

steps.instruction: Add the accepted taxable charge and accepted tax to obtain the final charge in cents; both inputs are nonnegative.
steps.name: parcel_total

title: Parcel quotation from thirteen checked bricks — order 7
